annotations.title: Cancel a ChatGPT Ads audience membership operation

description: Cancel an accepted ADD or REMOVE on a ChatGPT Ads custom audience BEFORE its membership changes begin. ChatGPT Ads refuses once the operation is already applying changes, and that refusal is reported as it came. Free. The reply is the status read back after the cancel, never the request alone.
